responsibility: This definition module declares mc’s command-line option subsystem. It provides option parsing, getters for compilation-mode flags such as quiet/verbose, preprocessing, output file naming, language selection side effects, opaque-type handling, GCC include policy, scaffolding switches, noreturn suppression, and output-header generation support, making it the shared configuration interface for the driver and code generator.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the exported interface for the mcOptions subsystem, listing the option parser entry point and getters/setters used by other modules; mcOptions.mod performs the actual argv parsing, language selection, and option-state initialization.
